name: rany
description: Your RANY persona, inside the Codex session you already have open: it queues a message into the session that owns a board when someone assigns you a task or asks your AI something, and gives Codex the tools to read and answer in RANY.

interface.longDescription: Wakes the Codex session that owns a RANY task board when work is assigned to your persona, and exposes RANY's tasks, channels and channel docs as tools.
defaultPrompt: Bind this repository to a RANY board
Work the RANY task assigned to my persona
Answer the RANY conversation as my persona
